notes: When mined 400 @resource/resource_gold.webp@(3600 left on node) all go to @resource/deer.webp@
If opponent go spears, then make @unit_jin/mohe-tribesman.webp@
When having 8 on @resource/resource_food.webp@, send them to @resource/boar.webp@/@resource/deer.webp@
@unit_jin/emissary.webp@ goes to neutral @building_economy/market.webp@ to use ability

description:
The ONLY Jin Dynasty Build You Need To Get Conqueror by Swaggy Professor. 

For a more simple version of this build, please check out murtuk's 'Copy for me to understand series' found here: https://aoe4guides.com/builds/tu8Z6S1y6myRbMBsEfWO
name: The ONLY Jin Dynasty Build You Need - Swaggy Professor
author: Niki45nk

notes: Use your @unit_cavalry/scout.webp@ to scout opponent's base
Immediately make a few @unit_jin/mohe-tribesman.webp@ from @landmark_jin/great-pasture.webp@ to defend
Always train @unit_jin/iron-pagoda.webp@ from @landmark_jin/great-pasture.webp@ (@unit_jin/mohe-tribesman.webp@ if you are spear rushed)

When you have 100 @resource/resource_wood.webp@, 1 @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@@unit_jin/mounted-villager.webp@ builds @building_jin/grassland.webp@ near @landmark_jin/great-pasture.webp@, then goes to @resource/resource_gold.webp@
Use your @unit_jin/iron-pagoda.webp@ to harass opponent's @unit_worker/villager-china.webp@ or defend your own
If opponent makes many @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@, make a few @unit_jin/mohe-tribesman.webp@
When you have 8 @resource/resource_food.webp@@unit_jin/mounted-villager.webp@, send them all to @resource/deer.webp@/@resource/boar.webp@ and build @building_economy/mill.webp@

description:
[Jin Dynasty] Late Game Build by Valdemar.

Warning: Based on the previous games with this Civ, it seems to be fairly weak early game, but very strong late game Civ. It may also be a bit of a advanced civilization to learn and master.
name: [Jin Dynasty] Knight Opener - Valdemar
author: Niki45nk

notes: If safe, Send 3 @unit_jin/mounted-villager.webp@ from @resource/sheep.webp@ to @building_economy/mill.webp@@resource/deer.webp@ (and build @building_defensive/outpost.webp@)
When @resource/sheep.webp@ run out, send @unit_jin/mounted-villager.webp@ to other @resource/resource_food.webp@ sources (and build @building_defensive/outpost.webp@ there too)
Build @building_military/stable.webp@ near @building_jin/grassland.webp@ and make @unit_jin/iron-pagoda.webp@ from there as well
Use your Cavalry to either attack opponent's @unit_worker/villager-china.webp@ or defend your own
After a good fight, send all @unit_worker/villager-china.webp@ at @resource/resource_wood.webp@ to @resource/resource_food.webp@ and @resource/resource_gold.webp@
6 Mounted and 2 Regular @resource/resource_food.webp@@unit_worker/villager-china.webp@ build @landmark_jin/dragon-pavilion.webp@near forward @resource/resource_gold.webp@ vein
Send @unit_jin/emissary.webp@ from @landmark_jin/dragon-pavilion.webp@ to Neutral Trade Posts
Build @building_economy/house.webp@, Once 5 on@resource/resource_gold.webp@,  @resource/rally.webp@@resource/resource_food.webp@(these vills will be used for age up)
Age up, @unit_worker/villager-china.webp@from age up go @resource/resource_food.webp@(Reindeer under TC)
Start prioritizing maxing out @unit_jin/mounted-villager.webp@as gold eco allows

description: Just for me to follow this build
name: Jin Dynasty: 2TC+Castle in 9 min!!
author: SkweezyLemon

notes: Kill reindeer @resource/deer.webp@ move 2 @unit_jin/mounted-villager.webp@ to @resource/resource_gold.webp@ and construct @building_economy/mining-camp.webp@, than @resource/rally.webp@@unit_jin/mounted-villager.webp@ to @resource/resource_food.webp@

When 4 @unit_jin/mounted-villager.webp@ on @resource/resource_food.webp@, @resource/rally.webp@ new @unit_jin/mounted-villager.webp@ to @resource/resource_gold.webp@ then back to @resource/resource_food.webp@

Take 2@resource/resource_gold.webp@@unit_jin/mounted-villager.webp@ to @resource/resource_wood.webp@ (construct @building_economy/lumber-camp.webp@), take 1@resource/resource_food.webp@@unit_jin/mounted-villager.webp@ to @resource/resource_wood.webp@, take 2@resource/resource_food.webp@@unit_jin/mounted-villager.webp@ to @resource/resource_stone.webp@, and @resource/rally.webp@ to @resource/resource_stone.webp@ for one. more @unit_jin/mounted-villager.webp@ than start producing @unit_worker/villager-china.webp@
Take age up @unit_jin/mounted-villager.webp@ to @resource/resource_wood.webp@, and use ability of @landmark_jin/flower-pagoda.webp@ on the woodline

Use all @resource/resource_wood.webp@@unit_jin/mounted-villager.webp@ to construct new @building_economy/town-center.webp@ closest to dens resources (eg woodline with nearby gold), move 1 @unit_jin/mounted-villager.webp@ to @resource/resource_gold.webp@

@resource/rally.webp@@unit_jin/mounted-villager.webp@/@unit_worker/villager-china.webp@ to @resource/resource_food.webp@ (make normal when you don't have the gold), take 2 @resource/resource_food.webp@@unit_jin/mounted-villager.webp@ to @resource/resource_gold.webp@, and @resource/rally.webp@ to @resource/resource_wood.webp@

Take all @resource/resource_wood.webp@@unit_jin/mounted-villager.webp@ and spread to get new division of villagers @resource/rally.webp@to @resource/resource_food.webp@, construct @building_economy/house.webp@ with @resource/resource_gold.webp@@unit_jin/mounted-villager.webp@ if necessary, remacro when hitting 600@resource/resource_gold.webp@, keep min 5 on @resource/resource_gold.webp@

Start age up with 8@resource/resource_food.webp@, move towards strategic position for @landmark_jin/dragon-pavilion.webp@, when hitting 1200@resource/resource_food.webp@ take 5@unit_jin/mounted-villager.webp@ to @resource/resource_wood.webp@
remacro start getting the first @unit_jin/emissary.webp@ tributary, start getting eco upgrades, get relics, build army
If @unit_cavalry/scout.webp@ found @resource/deer.webp@ kill 2-3 | send 3 @unit_jin/mounted-villager.webp@ @resource/resource_food.webp@ there with @building_economy/mill.webp@

description: Copied from Swaggy Professor's video for me to understand
name: Swaggy's 8 Minute Ender - Copy for me to understand series
author: murtuk

notes: Ready to force drop off to age up
Make more @unit_jin/mohe-tribesman.webp@ to defend your @unit_jin/iron-pagoda.webp@ raids, also pressure open points
when 400 mined @resource/resource_gold.webp@, build @building_economy/house.webp@ with one @unit_jin/mounted-villager.webp@and @resource/rally.webp@everyone on @resource/resource_food.webp@
age up completed, get 1 @unit_jin/mounted-villager.webp@on @resource/resource_gold.webp@and get 2 @unit_jin/mounted-villager.webp@on @resource/resource_wood.webp@near TC
when 100 @resource/resource_wood.webp@take 1 @unit_jin/mounted-villager.webp@ to build Grassland near Great Pasture
make Iron Pagoda and harass opponent (using both free horses and regular one). @resource/rally.webp@@resource/resource_food.webp@

when 8 @unit_jin/mounted-villager.webp@ on @resource/resource_food.webp@, take them to @resource/boar.webp@and get Mohe Ancestry @technology_jin/mohe-ancestry.webp@.  @resource/rally.webp@@resource/resource_gold.webp@
with 5 to 8 @unit_jin/mounted-villager.webp@build dragon pavillon to secure ressources elsewhere on the map depending on the ressource you want
play game normally : get unit, eco and blacksmith upgrade - build monestary, get sacred sites, relics, make counter units

description: Super fast Feudal with Great Pasture into immediate Mohe Tribesman production to pressure the opponent really early. Can get the first Mohe Tribesman into their back gold on 4:20 on average, and make a small fast very fast behind which you can either prolong feudal or go FC (safest option).
name: 3:30 Mohe Tribesman Rush into FC
author: Eldritch

notes: @resource/rally.webp@ the 3 next to @resource/resource_gold.webp@ and build a @building_economy/house.webp@ as well
@resource/rally.webp@ to Reindeers and shift-click to @resource/sheep.webp@ until age-up (so that the villagers automatically switch from Reindeers to Sheep once they're empty)
@resource/rally.webp@ 1 more @unit_worker/villager-china.webp@ to @resource/resource_wood.webp@ to have 3 in total
Constantly produce @unit_jin/mohe-tribesman.webp@ until 5-6 and pressure the opponent with them, try to keep them alive and harass villagers
Start queuing @unit_jin/mounted-villager.webp@ as soon as you have enough @resource/resource_gold.webp@ and @resource/rally.webp@ to @resource/resource_gold.webp@

Once 2 @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ are gathered, send 2 @resource/resource_wood.webp@ @unit_worker/villager-china.webp@ to @resource/resource_gold.webp@ and keep the other 2 on @resource/resource_wood.webp@
Don't hesitate to go on @resource/deer.webp@ with @unit_jin/mounted-villager.webp@ if safe to do so, research @technology_jin/mohe-ancestry.webp@ if you do that

Once the third @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ is gathered, build @building_economy/house.webp@ with 1 @resource/resource_wood.webp@ @unit_worker/villager-china.webp@ and send the other one on @resource/resource_food.webp@
Age-up with 8 @resource/resource_food.webp@ @unit_worker/villager-china.webp@ with @landmark_jin/dragon-pavilion.webp@ on your @resource/resource_gold.webp@ or other important resource node
Remacro some @unit_worker/villager-china.webp@ to @resource/resource_wood.webp@ to build production
